routes.name: Walking on the Moon
routes.desc: Directly through the lefthand corner. Slopers, smears and pockets.

routes.name: Steal Your Face
routes.desc: Just right of 'Walking on the Moon'. Start up the blunt arete, then climb up the left enduring face. 6 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

routes.name: Into the Mystic
routes.desc: 2nd pitch after Steal your face, climbing up and right through the gulley, reaching right on small feet. Continue up to the top, over the tuffa roof and cruising through the juggy top section. Amazing view, access to mountain top possible. Climb "Steal your Face" and "Into the Mystic" in one go with an 80m rope.

routes.name: Hell in a Bucket
routes.desc: Short but fun climb up onto the big ledge. Gives access to 'Soulshine', 'Imagine' and 'Dark Star'. Great climb for beginners/guiding. 4 slings.

routes.name: Soulshine
routes.desc: Lefthand line on the big ledge, up along a thin crack. Starts on the sling left below the anchor of 'Hell in a Bucket'. 25m from the ground. 5 titanium bolts, 3 slings, 1 fixed draw at the crux.

routes.name: Imagine
routes.desc: The middle line starting from the big ledge. Accessed by climbing 'Hell in a Bucket'. Shares the first 2 slings with 'Dark Star', then left up a white streak, following the yellow slings. 25m from the ground. 3 titanium bolts, 5 slings, 1 fixed draw.

routes.name: Dark Star
routes.desc: The righthand line starting from the big ledge accessed by 'Hell in a Bucket'. Shares the first two clips with 'Imagine', then right along the blue threads. 25m from the ground. 8 slings.

routes.name: Big Underwear / Dobolina
routes.desc: The right hand start from the ground. Climbs better than it looks. Intermediate anchor on the ledge for beginners/giuding, or skip and continue up to the tree. All slings.
